regression.finding: Before the fix, the exact inactive NoteForm configuration throws; nine other cases pass.

witnesses.browser: Pre-fix browser attempts reached real thread creation but stopped on audit selectors, not the product defect. The trigger selector and edit accessible-name prefix were corrected to the pinned host implementation. A later run reached edit/reply but asserted during the host optimistic-save transition; it now waits for the reply form to close. Whole-thread resolution uses the dedicated discussion control. The first passing persistence run captured the top of the page after reopening; the final run explicitly reveals and captures the verified thread. No pre-fix browser failure claim.
